name: Steven Rashford
text: White Square installed uPVC sliding windows and casement doors for our newly constructed villa. The sound insulation and finish are simply exceptional! Highly recommended.

name: Patrick James
text: Prompt service from measurement to installation. The team was professional, and the 10-year warranty gives us complete peace of mind. Excellent workmanship.

name: Anastasia Stone
text: We replaced our old wooden frames with JB White Square uPVC windows. The energy efficiency and reduced outside noise made a massive difference to our living room.
